data.title: Write isomorphic/BRANDING.md: isometric play-town design direction (labeled buildings as links)

data.body: Review (in-session, no sub-agent — session config forbids AgentTool unless requested). Read isomorphic/BRANDING.md against the plan's acceptance criteria: 621 lines, nine sections, register matches liquid/memphis. Verified the projection math by hand: --sq = tile/sqrt(2) yields a rhombus exactly --tile wide; left wall skewY(+26.565deg) anchored at the left vertex and right wall skewY(-26.565deg) anchored at the bottom vertex land on the correct rhombus vertices; roof translate(-50%, -50% - wall) centres correctly. Palette contrast numbers computed with a WCAG script, not guessed. Affordance law (labelled = link) stated in section 1 and enforced in sections 6/9. Build-contract specifics present (wrapper #site-isomorphic, isomorphic- prefixes, no fixed, no commas in functional pseudo-classes, single @import). Fixed inline during review: sign band moved to the lit left face to match the stated preference; the window-pattern snippet had a no-op second gradient, replaced with a working two-axis grid; the closing test said 'five searches' for four terms and would have flagged the legitimate ground-ellipse border-radius. No other repo file touched. Meets acceptance criteria. Follow-on: generating isomorphic/index.html and mapping a bucket in sites.config.json are separate tasks (cf. FA-6 for liquid).
